sections.title: TOEIC 金色證書 90 天訓練｜Day 7：第一週週測
sections.markdown:
今天不再加入大量新文法，而是做第一次整合：**詞性、五大句型、時態、主被動、to V / V-ing、Part 2 間接回答、Part 7 定位閱讀**。

目前沒有收到前 6 天的實際答題紀錄，因此今天採 **860+ 標準難度**。今天的週測成績可以作為第二週提高難度的基準。建議投入 **100～120 分鐘**。

sections.title: ① 本週核心單字總複習
sections.markdown:
前六天已接觸約 180 個字，今天不再硬塞 30 個全新字，而是挑出最值得形成「看到就懂」反射的 30 組。

| 英文 | 中文／搭配 |
|---|---|
| submit an application | 提交申請 |
| qualified candidate | 合格候選人 |
| apply for a position | 應徵職位 |
| meet the qualifications | 符合資格 |
| conduct an interview | 進行面試 |
| meet a deadline | 趕上期限 |
| submit a proposal | 提交提案 |
| reach an agreement | 達成協議 |
| request an extension | 要求延期 |
| within budget | 預算內 |
| launch a product | 推出產品 |
| customer satisfaction | 顧客滿意度 |
| request a refund | 要求退款 |
| respond to an inquiry | 回覆詢問 |
| conduct a survey | 進行調查 |
| competitive price | 有競爭力的價格 |
| make a reservation | 預約 |
| departure time | 出發時間 |
| baggage claim | 行李提領處 |
| travel expenses | 差旅費 |
| request reimbursement | 申請報銷 |
| routine maintenance | 定期維護 |
| safety inspection | 安全檢查 |
| replacement part | 替換零件 |
| function properly | 正常運作 |
| temporarily unavailable | 暫時無法使用 |
| employee benefits | 員工福利 |
| receive a promotion | 獲得升遷 |
| performance review | 績效評估 |
| eligible for | 符合……資格 |

今天的目標不是英翻中，而是看到：

> **eligible**

腦中直接出現：

> **eligible for**

看到：

> **respond**

直接想到：

> **respond to**

這才是 TOEIC 需要的單字能力。

---

sections.title: ② 第一週文法總整理
sections.markdown:
現在你的 Part 5 解題順序應該開始固定成：

**句子結構 → 詞性 → 時間 → 主被動 → 動詞搭配 → 語意確認**

例如：

> The new equipment _____ by technicians yesterday.

(A) inspected  
(B) was inspected  
(C) has inspected  
(D) inspecting

先找：

**yesterday → 過去**

再看：

equipment 是接受 inspect。

所以：

**過去 + 被動**

答案：

> **was inspected**

---

再看：

> The company is considering _____ another branch.

(A) open  
(B) opened  
(C) to open  
(D) opening

看到：

> consider

直接反射：

> **consider + V-ing**

答案：

**D**

---

再看：

> The project was completed _____.

(A) success  
(B) successful  
(C) successfully  
(D) succeed

completed 是動詞。

修飾動詞：

**副詞**

答案：

**C**

如果這三題都能在約 10～15 秒內判斷，第一週的文法核心已經開始建立。

---

sections.title: ③ Listening｜Part 2 週測
sections.markdown:
今天不要只看文字作答。每一題先用手機或電腦的英文朗讀功能念出問題與選項，**不要暫停、不要重播**，再選答案。

### Q1

> When will the maintenance work be completed?

(A) The technician hasn't given us an estimate.  
(B) On the third floor.  
(C) About four workers.

### Q2

> Who approved the new advertising campaign?

(A) It begins next Monday.  
(B) I believe the marketing director did.  
(C) About twenty thousand dollars.

### Q3

> Why don't we postpone the presentation?

(A) That's probably the best option.  
(B) In Conference Room 3.  
(C) At four thirty.

### Q4

> Have you submitted your expense report?

(A) I still need one receipt.  
(B) About three hundred dollars.  
(C) To the accounting department.

### Q5

> Where should visitors leave their luggage?

(A) The receptionist can show you.  
(B) Tomorrow afternoon.  
(C) About twenty kilograms.

### Q6

> Should I contact the supplier?

(A) I've already sent them an email.  
(B) The shipment arrived yesterday.  
(C) About fifty boxes.

### Q7

> Who's going to conduct the interviews?

(A) Didn't Ms. Lin volunteer?  
(B) At ten o'clock.  
(C) Eight candidates.

### Q8

> When does the new employee start?

(A) Human Resources hasn't announced it yet.  
(B) In the sales department.  
(C) She's very experienced.

答案：

**1A / 2B / 3A / 4A / 5A / 6A / 7A / 8A**

這一組故意幾乎沒有「直接回答」。

金色證書程度的 Part 2 必須逐漸擺脫：

> When → 找時間

真正應該變成：

> **聽懂對話意圖 → 找最自然的回應。**

---

sections.title: ④ Reading｜Part 7 週測
sections.markdown:
限時 **3 分鐘**。

> **To:** All Staff  
> **From:** Facilities Management  
> **Subject:** Office Renovation
>
> Renovation work on the third floor will begin on September 14 and is expected to continue for approximately two weeks. During this period, employees in the Sales and Marketing departments will temporarily work on the fifth floor.
>
> Employees should move all personal belongings from their desks before leaving the office on September 11. Computers and other office equipment will be relocated by the facilities team over the weekend.
>
> Please note that Conference Rooms 3A and 3B will be unavailable during the renovation. Meetings currently scheduled in these rooms should be moved to another available meeting space.
>
> Employees who need assistance relocating equipment should submit a request through the facilities portal by September 10.
>
> We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your cooperation.

### Q1

What is the purpose of the email?

(A) To announce an office renovation  
(B) To introduce new employees  
(C) To change company policies  
(D) To advertise office equipment

### Q2

Which employees will temporarily move?

(A) Human Resources employees  
(B) Sales and Marketing employees  
(C) Facilities employees  
(D) Accounting employees

### Q3

What should employees do by September 11?

(A) Submit an expense report  
(B) Reserve a conference room  
(C) Remove personal belongings  
(D) Move their computers

### Q4

Who will move the computers?

(A) Employees themselves  
(B) An outside company  
(C) The facilities team  
(D) The IT department

### Q5

What will happen to meetings scheduled in Rooms 3A and 3B?

(A) They will be canceled  
(B) They should be relocated  
(C) They will be held online  
(D) They will be postponed for two weeks

### Q6

What must employees do if they need relocation assistance?

(A) Email their supervisor  
(B) Contact Human Resources  
(C) Submit an online request  
(D) Visit the fifth floor

答案：

**1A / 2B / 3C / 4C / 5B / 6C**

這篇真正要練的是「定位」。

例如 Q4：

> Who will move the computers?

不要重新讀全文。

直接搜尋：

> computers

旁邊就是：

> will be relocated by the facilities team

sections.title: ⑦ 週測答案
sections.markdown:
**1C / 2B / 3B / 4B / 5B / 6C / 7B / 8B / 9B / 10D**

**11A / 12B / 13A / 14B / 15A / 16B / 17B / 18C / 19A / 20A**

其中五個必須完全理解：

> **has launched since January**

現在完成式。

> **are required to register**

被要求做某事。

> **suggested postponing**

suggest + V-ing。

> **responsible for training**

介系詞 for + V-ing。

> **will be installed**

未來式 + 被動。

---

sections.title: ⑧ 今天的錯題分析方式
sections.markdown:
週測不要只算分數。

每一題錯誤請標：

**V** = Vocabulary  
**G** = Grammar  
**L** = Listening  
**M** = Misread  
**T** = Time  
**TR** = Trap

例如 Q3 錯：

> Q3 → G → 忘記 suggest + V-ing

Q12 錯：

> Q12 → L/TR → 一直等 When 的時間答案，沒接受間接回答

這比單純寫「18/20」有價值得多。

---

sections.title: ⑨ 第一週能力評估
sections.markdown:
今天 20 題週測可以用這個標準：

| 成績 | 第二週策略 |
|---:|---|
| 19–20 | 提升到 900+ 難度 |
| 17–18 | 維持 860+，增加速度 |
| 14–16 | 加強弱點但繼續進度 |
| 10–13 | 第二週增加文法複習 |
| 0–9 | 降低速度，先鞏固第一週 |

金色證書目標不應只追求正確率。

Part 5 最終希望做到：

**30 題約 10 分鐘**

也就是平均：

**約 20 秒／題。**

目前第一週可以先接受約 **25～30 秒／題**。

---

sections.title: ⑩ 今日作業
sections.markdown:
今天不要再增加大量新內容。

第一件事，把週測所有錯題重新做一次，而且必須說出「為什麼另外三個答案錯」。

第二件事，把以下十個結構默寫出來：

> plan **to V**  
> decide **to V**  
> expect **to V**  
> agree **to V**  
> consider **V-ing**  
> avoid **V-ing**  
> suggest **V-ing**  
> finish **V-ing**  
> look forward to **V-ing**  
> be responsible for **V-ing**

第三件事，把下面四個結構朗讀三次：

> The equipment **is inspected** regularly.

> The equipment **was inspected** yesterday.

> The equipment **has been inspected** already.

> The equipment **will be inspected** tomorrow.

最後把今天的 20 題週測在睡前重新做一次，第二次限制 **6 分鐘**，目標 **20/20**。

第一週到今天結束。你現在應該已經建立第一套 TOEIC 解題框架：

> **不要逐字翻譯 → 找結構 → 找時間 → 判斷詞性／語態／搭配 → 最後確認語意。**

**Day 8** 將進入第二週，主題是 **分詞（V-ing / V-ed）**。從 Day 8 開始，Part 5 會加入更多「看起來兩個答案都合理」的 860+ 陷阱，同時逐步增加 Part 7 的篇幅與限時要求。

# TOEIC 金色證書 90 天訓練｜Day 7：第一週週測

今天不再加入大量新文法，而是做第一次整合：**詞性、五大句型、時態、主被動、to V / V-ing、Part 2 間接回答、Part 7 定位閱讀**。

目前沒有收到前 6 天的實際答題紀錄，因此今天採 **860+ 標準難度**。今天的週測成績可以作為第二週提高難度的基準。建議投入 **100～120 分鐘**。

## ① 本週核心單字總複習

前六天已接觸約 180 個字，今天不再硬塞 30 個全新字，而是挑出最值得形成「看到就懂」反射的 30 組。

| 英文 | 中文／搭配 |
|---|---|
| submit an application | 提交申請 |
| qualified candidate | 合格候選人 |
| apply for a position | 應徵職位 |
| meet the qualifications | 符合資格 |
| conduct an interview | 進行面試 |
| meet a deadline | 趕上期限 |
| submit a proposal | 提交提案 |
| reach an agreement | 達成協議 |
| request an extension | 要求延期 |
| within budget | 預算內 |
| launch a product | 推出產品 |
| customer satisfaction | 顧客滿意度 |
| request a refund | 要求退款 |
| respond to an inquiry | 回覆詢問 |
| conduct a survey | 進行調查 |
| competitive price | 有競爭力的價格 |
| make a reservation | 預約 |
| departure time | 出發時間 |
| baggage claim | 行李提領處 |
| travel expenses | 差旅費 |
| request reimbursement | 申請報銷 |
| routine maintenance | 定期維護 |
| safety inspection | 安全檢查 |
| replacement part | 替換零件 |
| function properly | 正常運作 |
| temporarily unavailable | 暫時無法使用 |
| employee benefits | 員工福利 |
| receive a promotion | 獲得升遷 |
| performance review | 績效評估 |
| eligible for | 符合……資格 |

今天的目標不是英翻中，而是看到：

> **eligible**

腦中直接出現：

> **eligible for**

看到：

> **respond**

直接想到：

> **respond to**

這才是 TOEIC 需要的單字能力。

---

# ② 第一週文法總整理

現在你的 Part 5 解題順序應該開始固定成：

**句子結構 → 詞性 → 時間 → 主被動 → 動詞搭配 → 語意確認**

例如：

> The new equipment _____ by technicians yesterday.

(A) inspected  
(B) was inspected  
(C) has inspected  
(D) inspecting

先找：

**yesterday → 過去**

再看：

equipment 是接受 inspect。

所以：

**過去 + 被動**

答案：

> **was inspected**

---

再看：

> The company is considering _____ another branch.

(A) open  
(B) opened  
(C) to open  
(D) opening

看到：

> consider

直接反射：

> **consider + V-ing**

答案：

**D**

---

再看：

> The project was completed _____.

(A) success  
(B) successful  
(C) successfully  
(D) succeed

completed 是動詞。

修飾動詞：

**副詞**

答案：

**C**

如果這三題都能在約 10～15 秒內判斷，第一週的文法核心已經開始建立。

---

# ③ Listening｜Part 2 週測

今天不要只看文字作答。每一題先用手機或電腦的英文朗讀功能念出問題與選項，**不要暫停、不要重播**，再選答案。

### Q1

> When will the maintenance work be completed?

(A) The technician hasn't given us an estimate.  
(B) On the third floor.  
(C) About four workers.

### Q2

> Who approved the new advertising campaign?

(A) It begins next Monday.  
(B) I believe the marketing director did.  
(C) About twenty thousand dollars.

### Q3

> Why don't we postpone the presentation?

(A) That's probably the best option.  
(B) In Conference Room 3.  
(C) At four thirty.

### Q4

> Have you submitted your expense report?

(A) I still need one receipt.  
(B) About three hundred dollars.  
(C) To the accounting department.

### Q5

> Where should visitors leave their luggage?

(A) The receptionist can show you.  
(B) Tomorrow afternoon.  
(C) About twenty kilograms.

### Q6

> Should I contact the supplier?

(A) I've already sent them an email.  
(B) The shipment arrived yesterday.  
(C) About fifty boxes.

### Q7

> Who's going to conduct the interviews?

(A) Didn't Ms. Lin volunteer?  
(B) At ten o'clock.  
(C) Eight candidates.

### Q8

> When does the new employee start?

(A) Human Resources hasn't announced it yet.  
(B) In the sales department.  
(C) She's very experienced.

答案：

**1A / 2B / 3A / 4A / 5A / 6A / 7A / 8A**

這一組故意幾乎沒有「直接回答」。

金色證書程度的 Part 2 必須逐漸擺脫：

> When → 找時間

真正應該變成：

> **聽懂對話意圖 → 找最自然的回應。**

---

# ④ Reading｜Part 7 週測

限時 **3 分鐘**。

> **To:** All Staff  
> **From:** Facilities Management  
> **Subject:** Office Renovation
>
> Renovation work on the third floor will begin on September 14 and is expected to continue for approximately two weeks. During this period, employees in the Sales and Marketing departments will temporarily work on the fifth floor.
>
> Employees should move all personal belongings from their desks before leaving the office on September 11. Computers and other office equipment will be relocated by the facilities team over the weekend.
>
> Please note that Conference Rooms 3A and 3B will be unavailable during the renovation. Meetings currently scheduled in these rooms should be moved to another available meeting space.
>
> Employees who need assistance relocating equipment should submit a request through the facilities portal by September 10.
>
> We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your cooperation.

### Q1

What is the purpose of the email?

(A) To announce an office renovation  
(B) To introduce new employees  
(C) To change company policies  
(D) To advertise office equipment

### Q2

Which employees will temporarily move?

(A) Human Resources employees  
(B) Sales and Marketing employees  
(C) Facilities employees  
(D) Accounting employees

### Q3

What should employees do by September 11?

(A) Submit an expense report  
(B) Reserve a conference room  
(C) Remove personal belongings  
(D) Move their computers

### Q4

Who will move the computers?

(A) Employees themselves  
(B) An outside company  
(C) The facilities team  
(D) The IT department

### Q5

What will happen to meetings scheduled in Rooms 3A and 3B?

(A) They will be canceled  
(B) They should be relocated  
(C) They will be held online  
(D) They will be postponed for two weeks

### Q6

What must employees do if they need relocation assistance?

(A) Email their supervisor  
(B) Contact Human Resources  
(C) Submit an online request  
(D) Visit the fifth floor

答案：

**1A / 2B / 3C / 4C / 5B / 6C**

這篇真正要練的是「定位」。

例如 Q4：

> Who will move the computers?

不要重新讀全文。

直接搜尋：

> computers

旁邊就是：

> will be relocated by the facilities team

# ⑥ Day 7 第一週正式小考

這一區不要先看解析。

給自己 **7 分鐘，20 題**。

### Q1

### Q2

---

# ⑦ 週測答案

**1C / 2B / 3B / 4B / 5B / 6C / 7B / 8B / 9B / 10D**

**11A / 12B / 13A / 14B / 15A / 16B / 17B / 18C / 19A / 20A**

其中五個必須完全理解：

> **has launched since January**

現在完成式。

> **are required to register**

被要求做某事。

> **suggested postponing**

suggest + V-ing。

> **responsible for training**

介系詞 for + V-ing。

> **will be installed**

未來式 + 被動。

---

# ⑧ 今天的錯題分析方式

週測不要只算分數。

每一題錯誤請標：

**V** = Vocabulary  
**G** = Grammar  
**L** = Listening  
**M** = Misread  
**T** = Time  
**TR** = Trap

例如 Q3 錯：

> Q3 → G → 忘記 suggest + V-ing

Q12 錯：

> Q12 → L/TR → 一直等 When 的時間答案，沒接受間接回答

這比單純寫「18/20」有價值得多。

---

# ⑨ 第一週能力評估

今天 20 題週測可以用這個標準：

| 成績 | 第二週策略 |
|---:|---|
| 19–20 | 提升到 900+ 難度 |
| 17–18 | 維持 860+，增加速度 |
| 14–16 | 加強弱點但繼續進度 |
| 10–13 | 第二週增加文法複習 |
| 0–9 | 降低速度，先鞏固第一週 |

金色證書目標不應只追求正確率。

Part 5 最終希望做到：

**30 題約 10 分鐘**

也就是平均：

**約 20 秒／題。**

目前第一週可以先接受約 **25～30 秒／題**。

---

# ⑩ 今日作業

今天不要再增加大量新內容。

第一件事，把週測所有錯題重新做一次，而且必須說出「為什麼另外三個答案錯」。

第二件事，把以下十個結構默寫出來：

> plan **to V**  
> decide **to V**  
> expect **to V**  
> agree **to V**  
> consider **V-ing**  
> avoid **V-ing**  
> suggest **V-ing**  
> finish **V-ing**  
> look forward to **V-ing**  
> be responsible for **V-ing**

第三件事，把下面四個結構朗讀三次：

> The equipment **is inspected** regularly.

> The equipment **was inspected** yesterday.

> The equipment **has been inspected** already.

> The equipment **will be inspected** tomorrow.

最後把今天的 20 題週測在睡前重新做一次，第二次限制 **6 分鐘**，目標 **20/20**。

第一週到今天結束。你現在應該已經建立第一套 TOEIC 解題框架：

> **不要逐字翻譯 → 找結構 → 找時間 → 判斷詞性／語態／搭配 → 最後確認語意。**

**Day 8** 將進入第二週，主題是 **分詞（V-ing / V-ed）**。從 Day 8 開始，Part 5 會加入更多「看起來兩個答案都合理」的 860+ 陷阱，同時逐步增加 Part 7 的篇幅與限時要求。
